about: a count ignores the order and the page
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT o.id FROM fts CROSS JOIN search_text st ON st.doc = fts.rowid CROSS JOIN objects o ON o.id = st.object_id WHERE fts MATCH ? AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM object_types ot WHERE ot.object_id = o.id AND ot.type_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))))
